title: Quest journal
idea: Quest journal: Active objective and confirmed progress precede optional narrative
audience: People who need to track quest within a game surface.
avoidWhen: The journal substitutes for missing world feedback
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic document layout through its track quest priority and explicit commitment contract: Progress is recorded only from actual quest events
navigation: Quest journal keeps the current track quest context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Active objective and confirmed progress precede optional narrative
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to track quest; players return after interruption
composition.priority: Progress is recorded only from actual quest events

imagery.role: Support the actual track quest context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Allow readable narrative without hiding tracking control
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the quest journal structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no track quest content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Progress is recorded only from actual quest events
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized track quest content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Progress is recorded only from actual quest events
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active track quest context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
